exact_input_locators: §0.2(2), printed p.3: complex analytic spaces are included.

Theorem 1.6, printed p.5: for compact underlying X, a finite sequence of ambient blowups with smooth admissible centres makes the strict transform smooth and simultaneously normal crossing with the exceptional divisor.
The paragraph immediately after Theorem 1.6, p.5, also gives the relatively quasi-compact and locally finite analytic scopes.
Remarks 1.7(1)–(2), pp.5–6: the analytic coherence/semicontinuity scope and reduced-complex-analytic geometric strict transform.
application_map: Take X=D=(h^{-1}(0))_red inside the smooth dominating connected component U0. D is compact by properness. The theorem gives a finite composite π:Ũ→U0. Each centre lies over D, so π restricts to a biholomorphism off D, in particular π_t:Ũ_t→U_t for t≠0. The union of the final strict transform and exceptional divisors is the reduced support of (h∘π)^{-1}(0), hence normal crossing; multiplicities are retained as vanishing orders of h∘π. Blowups of smooth ambient manifolds along smooth centres keep the ambient manifold smooth and are proper.
